notes.title: DragonStone Revenge v1.2 minor update addresses full screen launch
notes.content: DragonStone Revenge v1.2 minor update addresses full screen launch, locking some users out of a usable game resolution. The game will now launch in windowed mode, which should now allow all users to access the settings menu and choose a game resolution that best fits their system.

notes.title: DragonStone Revenge – 1 Day Left!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396293/a77fbee6d3eff44374a6984f3e7cde3ed060fa90.png"]Myranda's journey is full of dangers and pleasures. Will you help her get revenge and save the world?

[hr][/hr]

Vengeance and romance go side-by-side.
DragonStone Revenge launches tomorrow! Play as Myranda, a warrior betrayed and cast out who returns to a world filled with corruption. Driven by revenge and a need to uncover the truth about her past, she must rise as the last heir to a powerful bloodline.

Only she can unlock the DragonStone and decide the future of the realm. The choices you make will shape her relationships and determine the outcome of the war.

Explore a detailed world full of secrets, danger, and dangerous beauty. Combine sword fighting, stealth, and forbidden magic to defeat your enemies. You can form close bonds with allies and lovers, but not everyone can be trusted. As the DragonStone’s power grows inside her, a darker side begins to surface. It’s up to you to guide her path and decide who she becomes.
[hr][/hr]

Get ready for the launch tomorrow! Wishlist now!
